--c.help: Cookies to use for the requests (dir mode only)

--discover-backup.help: Upon finding a file search for backup files by appending multiple backup extensions (default: false)

--discover-pattern.help: File containing replacement patterns applied to successful guesses

--domain.help: the domain to append when using an IP address as URL. If left empty and you specify a domain based URL the hostname from the URL is extracted

--exclude-length.help: exclude the following content lengths (completely ignores the status). You can separate multiple lengths by comma and it also supports ranges like 203-206

--exclude-status.help: exclude the following status codes. Can also handle ranges like 200,300-400,404.

--exclude-statuscodes.help: Excluded status codes. Can also handle ranges like 200,300-400,404.

--excludestatuscodes.help: Negative status codes (will override statuscodes if set)

--extensions-file.help: Read file extension(s) to search from the file

--f.help: Append a forward-slash to each directory request (dir mode only)

--force.help: Force execution even when result is not guaranteed. (default: false)

--fw.help: Force continued operation when wildcard found

--hide-length.help: Hide the length of the body in the output (default: false)

--include-length.help: Include the length of the body in the output

--includelength.help: Include the length of the body in the output

--interface.help: specify network interface to use. Can't be used with local-ip

--l.help: Include the length of the body in the output (dir mode only)

--no-fqdn.help: Do not automatically add a trailing dot to the domain, so the resolver uses the DNS search domain (default: false)

--o.help: Output file to write results to (defaults to stdout)

--output.help: Output file to write results to (defaults to stdout)

--p.help: Proxy to use for requests [http(s)://host:port] (dir mode only)

--q.help: Don't print the banner and other noise

--quiet.help: Don't print the banner and other noise (default: false)

--random-agent.help: Use a random User-Agent string (default: false)

--resolver.help: Use custom DNS server (format server.com or server.com:port)

--retry.help: Should retry on request timeout (default: false)
